changelog: Recommends the keyless default path and the stellar-agent-wallet skill (shawnmuggle/stellar-agentic-wallet) over configuring .env hot-wallet keys, demoting the .env template to unattended EVM/Solana automation with a dedicated low-balance hot wallet, across SKILL.md and all eight localized docs; declares the skill's permissions (network endpoints, env vars, filesystem access, signing cap) in SKILL.md metadata, answering the ClawHub audit's 13 Credential Access findings and Lp3.
summary: Pay an OpenRouter Coinbase Payment Link with Stellar, Solana, BNB Chain, Ethereum, Polygon, Base (USDT/USDC) or Bitcoin Lightning. A bridge creates a one-time deposit order for the coin you actually hold, then a funder wallet settles the Coinbase invoice for you. Use when a payments.coinbase.com/payment-links/pl_* (or payment-sessions/paymentSession_*) URL should be paid with any of these coins, or on "rozo-checkout" / "pay this link with bitcoin".
